text: ぼくと　おまえで　カセキを　１こ　ずつ　だ！

structure.jp: カセキを　１こ　ずつ　だ！

patterns.name: 〜ずつ
patterns.explanation: ずつ after an amount means that much for each one. １こ　ずつ = 'one each'.

patterns.name: 〜で (group)
patterns.explanation: で after people says who is doing it together as a group. ぼくと　おまえで = 'between me and you'.
